ruleDefinitions.name: SQLite Chromium Profile Data DB Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect usage of the "sqlite" binary to query databases in Chromium-based browsers for potential data stealing.

sequences.query: ((process_product = "SQLite" OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlite\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sqlite3\\\.exe$"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\User\\ Data\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Opera\\ Software\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ChromiumViewer\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Login\\ Data.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Cookies.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Web\\ Data.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*History.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Bookmarks.*")))
